scenario: Registered gateway connects and shows active; inactive after it stops
steps: Start gateway; GET /gateways/{id}; stop gateway; GET again
expected_result: isActive true while connected, false after disconnect

scenario: Token rotation keeps the old token valid until it is revoked
steps: POST tokens (T2); restart gateway with T1; revoke T1; restart with T1; restart with T2
expected_result: T1 works before revoke; fails after; T2 works

scenario: At most two active tokens per gateway
expected_result: Refused or oldest revoked, as documented

scenario: Manifest with a mismatched version or type is refused
preconditions: Gateway registered as type event or with a different version
steps: Start a regular controller with that token
expected_result: Manifest POST 409; gateway not marked active; no deployments delivered

scenario: Deleting a gateway removes its tokens and deployments
expected_result: Gateway disconnected and cannot reconnect; deployments gone from history

scenario: Custom policies from the gateway manifest are listed in the control plane
preconditions: Gateway built with a custom policy
expected_result: Custom policy and version listed; usable in an API policy
